reason: Adds a visual agent-workflow canvas and a multi-model evaluation lab with workflow execution, benchmark runs, result inspection, and optional desktop launching for DeepSeek Harness.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可视化智能体工作流编辑与运行，以及针对多个模型提供商的基准评测和结果查看功能。
summaries.en: Adds visual agent workflow editing and execution to DeepSeek Harness, along with multi-provider benchmark evaluation and result inspection.

capabilities: Creates and runs visual agent workflows
Executes multi-model benchmark suites against configured provider routes
Stores and displays workflow and benchmark run results
Imports and exports benchmark suites and run data
Provides a desktop launcher for an isolated local Harness profile
